summary: Make mission-page query budgets and concurrent quick-agent fixtures deterministic

replay.detail: The mission-page read is extracted without changing its queries or snapshot, and two tests change their validation/fixture. No replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers, schema versions or migration code change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination behavior change.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, provider or harness contract changes. The HTTP handler uses the same page read and the quick-agent idempotency implementation is unchanged.

downtime.detail: These test changes and behavior-preserving page-read extraction add no service interruption.

manual.detail: No installation steps or starting-state transitions are required.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery or database swap-back behavior changes.
